renderers.artifact: Write <name>.src.html with the html/ components and the named type, then html/scripts/build.mjs --verify. Read the exemplar for structure only.
renderers.bespoke: Write one self-contained page modeled on the exemplar, with its interaction in inline CSS and JS. Add dark mode and 12px minimum text, which the exemplars lack, then run html/scripts/verify.mjs on it.
renderers.solve: Run the decision workflow, then bin/render-report --html. The renderer writes the page; do not hand-write it.
